generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A positive branch can bypass explicit negative semantic evidence, and an early return can select one accepted representation before detecting contradictions from peers.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Evaluate negative evidence only in an ambiguous-name branch or return a preferred structured value before collecting all accepted sources.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Apply explicit negative evidence before every positive branch and collect all accepted equivalent representations before applying precedence or effects.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Cross product negative evidence with each representation shape; test coherent equivalence and pairwise conflicts through the material effect.
